question: A support team lead creates a Claude Project and wants Claude to always answer in a formal tone and respond as a senior support engineer for every conversation in that workspace, without repeating those directions in each chat. What should the lead configure?
options: A) Upload a text file describing the tone to the knowledge base and name the file 'instructions.txt'
B) Create a separate project for every tone and role combination the support team might ever need
C) Paste the tone and role guidance into the opening message of each new chat inside the project
D) Set project instructions defining the tone and role, since these apply automatically to every chat
correct_answers: D) Set project instructions defining the tone and role, since these apply automatically to every chat
explanations: Incorrect. A file named like instructions is still treated as knowledge base content, not as project-level behavioral instructions.
Incorrect. Creating a project per tone combination is unnecessary overhead when a single project's instructions field already covers this need.
Incorrect. Repeating guidance in every chat defeats the purpose of project instructions, which persist automatically across chats.
Correct. Project instructions are built specifically to establish behavioral guidelines, such as tone and role, that Claude applies to all chats within that project.
